'''Madak''', also known as Mandak, is an [[Austronesian language]] spoken in [[New Ireland Province|New Ireland]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. The [[Library of Congress]] subject classification uses ''Mandak''.

Additionally, Madak has the following diphthongs: /ei/, /ai/, /iu/, /ao/, /au/.

Stress is predictable, occurring on the second syllable. Syllables containing the consonants /ɣ/, /β/, or /r/ are skipped when determining stress.<ref name=":0" />
